name: Bitwarden Security Posture
description: Assessing a client's Bitwarden organization posture from the read-only Public API: which security policies are enabled and how they are set, two-step login coverage across confirmed members, owner and admin sprawl, members stuck in Invited or Accepted, and the SSO caveat on the 2FA flag. Produces a scored posture summary with remediation steps for the Admin Console.
